question: For ACTIVE networks (excluding shared networks where the RBAC action is 'access_as_shared' and the target tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), list each network’s name, status, and admin_state_up along with its RBAC action, target tenant, and dense-rank-by-network-ID window column, and also include (for the 'access_as_shared' RBAC action) the average, range (max–min), and variance of subnet IP version (restricted to IP versions 4 and 6) for subnets whose network is referenced by that RBAC entry. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT n.id AS network_id, n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up,
         r.action, r.target_tenant,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column
  FROM networks n
  LEFT JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id
  WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM networkrbacs r2 
      WHERE r2.object_id = n.id 
        AND r2.action = 'access_as_shared' 
        AND r2.target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
    )
),
stats AS (
  SELECT r.object_id AS network_id,
         AVG(s.ip_version) AS avg_ip_version,
         MAX(s.ip_version) - MIN(s.ip_version) AS ip_version_range,
         VARIANCE(s.ip_version) AS ip_version_variance
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = r.object_id
  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' 
    AND s.ip_version IN (4, 6)
  GROUP BY r.object_id
)
SELECT b.name, b.status, b.admin_state_up, b.action, b.target_tenant, b.window_column,
       CASE WHEN b.action = 'access_as_shared' THEN st.avg_ip_version END AS avg_subnet_ip_version,
       CASE WHEN b.action = 'access_as_shared' THEN st.ip_version_range END AS subnet_ip_version_range,
       CASE WHEN b.action = 'access_as_shared' THEN st.ip_version_variance END AS subnet_ip_version_variance
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN stats st ON st.network_id = b.network_id
ORDER BY b.network_id, b.action, b.target_tenant
